section_summary: Pages 151–189 continue an English guide to Japan’s revised House of Representatives election law. They cover voting, counting, candidates, campaigns, expenses, offences, lawsuits, electoral districts and supplementary rules. Pages 190–197 contain a 1947 Home Affairs ordinance on reporting campaign income and expenses, followed by two reporting forms.

subfiles.title: Guide to the revised Law for the Election of Members of the House of Representatives, including electoral district annex and supplementary rules
subfiles.about: Continues the translated election law and commentary, then lists electoral districts and transitional amendments.
subfiles.summary: The text sets rules for polling, ballot counting, election meetings, candidacy, vacancies and court challenges. It also regulates campaigns and expenses and prescribes penalties for bribery, intimidation, voting fraud and other offences. An annex lists electoral districts and seat quotas throughout Japan. Supplementary rules address the coming general election and changes to related local election laws.

subfiles.title: Ordinance Concerning Publicity on Election Expenses
subfiles.from: Seiichi Omura, Minister of Home Affairs
subfiles.about: Prescribes reporting, publication and inspection of election campaign income and expenses.
subfiles.summary: Home Affairs Ordinance No. 1 of 1947, as amended by Ordinance No. 16, defines campaign expenses, receipts and responsible disbursers. It requires candidates and supporting organizations to file reports with election administration committees or the Minister of Home Affairs on specified schedules. Authorities must publish report outlines and preserve the filings for public inspection; false or missing reports carry penalties. A concluding note summarizes reporting deadlines.

subfiles.title: Annex Form No. 1: Report of Estimate of Incomes and Disbursements of Election Campaign Expenses
subfiles.about: Blank candidate campaign income and disbursement report.
subfiles.summary: Form for itemizing a candidate’s campaign income and disbursements.

subfiles.title: Annex Form No. 2: Report of Estimate of Incomes and Disbursements of Expenses of Parties, Associations and Other Organizations
subfiles.from: Principal officer of party, association or other organization
subfiles.to: Minister for Home Affairs or Chairman of Election Administration Committee
subfiles.about: Blank organizational campaign income and disbursement report.
subfiles.summary: Form for reporting an organization’s election campaign income.
